review_note: Source and bilingual content reviewed by implementation agent; illustrative examples are original, not empirical outcome claims.

cn.name: 约束理论
cn.description: 围绕限制系统整体产出的约束安排改进，并使其他环节配合它。
trigger: 大家都很忙但越来越慢，改进了很多部门却没有增加交付。
questions: 当前限制整体交付的因素是什么？改善它会改变哪个结果？
avoid_when: 未明确系统目标和边界时，不能凭忙碌程度判定唯一约束。
examples: 说明性示例：团队每周写完 20 项功能却只能验收 5 项；先调查验收队列，再决定是否继续增加开发投入。
cn.source_text:
TOC Institute — Theory of Constraints, The Core Idea / Constraints / What is TOC
https://www.tocinstitute.org/theory-of-constraints.html
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Theory of Constraints
en.description: Improve system output by focusing on its limiting constraint and aligning other activities with it.
trigger: Everyone is busy but delivery is getting slower.
questions: What limits completed delivery, and which outcome would change if it improved?
avoid_when: Define the system goal and boundary before identifying a constraint; busyness alone is insufficient.
examples: Illustrative example: A team codes 20 features but accepts only five weekly. Investigate the acceptance queue before adding developers.
en.source_text:
TOC Institute — Theory of Constraints, The Core Idea / Constraints / What is TOC
https://www.tocinstitute.org/theory-of-constraints.html
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 五步聚焦法
cn.description: 识别约束、充分利用约束、让其他环节配合、提升约束能力，再重新识别，避免惯性。
trigger: 已经找到卡点，却不知道先协调流程还是先增人。
questions: 现有约束能力是否被浪费？其他环节需要怎样配合？
avoid_when: 不能跳过验证约束，或把增人视为每次改进的第一步。
examples: 说明性示例：先保护评审人的专注时段，让提交材料齐备；仍不够时再扩充评审能力，然后重新检查瓶颈。
cn.source_text:
TOC Institute — Five Focusing Steps, steps 1–5
https://www.tocinstitute.org/five-focusing-steps.html
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Five Focusing Steps
en.description: Identify the constraint, exploit it, subordinate other work, elevate it, and repeat without inertia.
trigger: We found a bottleneck but are unsure whether to reorganize or hire first.
questions: Is existing constraint capacity wasted, and what must other activities change?
avoid_when: Do not skip identifying the constraint or assume hiring is always the first step.
examples: Illustrative example: Protect review time and require complete submissions before expanding review capacity, then reassess the constraint.
en.source_text:
TOC Institute — Five Focusing Steps, steps 1–5
https://www.tocinstitute.org/five-focusing-steps.html
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 瓶颈
cn.description: 在给定需求和流程中，限制整体通过能力的环节或资源。
trigger: 工作总在同一个环节排队，前面越快后面积压越多。
questions: 哪里持续积压？它的有效处理能力和到达量各是多少？
avoid_when: 短暂排队不必然代表系统瓶颈；需求、返工和停机都可能改变判断。
examples: 说明性示例：设计每天交付 8 项，验证只能完成 3 项；继续增加设计产出会先扩大待验证队列。
cn.source_text:
Brent Wahba, Lean Enterprise Institute — What’s Your Company’s Bottleneck? (2014-01-14)
https://www.lean.org/the-lean-post/articles/whats-your-companys-bottleneck/
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Bottleneck
en.description: A step or resource that limits overall throughput under the current demand and process.
trigger: Work repeatedly queues at the same step while upstream output increases.
questions: Where does work accumulate, and how do effective capacity and arrivals compare?
avoid_when: A temporary queue does not prove a system bottleneck; demand, rework and downtime matter.
examples: Illustrative example: Design delivers eight items daily while validation completes three. More design output initially expands the validation queue.
en.source_text:
Brent Wahba, Lean Enterprise Institute — What’s Your Company’s Bottleneck? (2014-01-14)
https://www.lean.org/the-lean-post/articles/whats-your-companys-bottleneck/
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 排队论
cn.description: 研究到达、服务能力及其随机变化如何影响等待时间和队列长度。
trigger: 大家都很忙但越来越慢；平均产能似乎够，等待却越来越长。
questions: 到达和处理时间的波动有多大？工作是在处理还是等待？
avoid_when: 套用 M/M/1 等公式前须验证对应假设，不能把所有流程视为单服务台。
examples: 说明性示例：支持团队日均容量充足，但请求集中在下午；先记录到达和处理时间，判断波动造成的等待。
cn.source_text:
Eytan Modiano, MIT — Introduction to Queueing Theory, 6.263/16.37 Lectures 5 & 6, slides 3, 10, 16–20
https://web.mit.edu/modiano/www/6.263/lec5-6.pdf
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Queueing Theory
en.description: Studies how arrivals, service capacity and variability affect waiting times and queue lengths.
trigger: Average capacity looks sufficient, yet waiting keeps increasing.
questions: How variable are arrivals and service times, and where is work waiting?
avoid_when: Check assumptions before applying formulas such as M/M/1; many workflows have multiple servers or dependencies.
examples: Illustrative example: A support desk has enough daily capacity but receives an afternoon burst. Record arrival and service times to investigate delays.
en.source_text:
Eytan Modiano, MIT — Introduction to Queueing Theory, 6.263/16.37 Lectures 5 & 6, slides 3, 10, 16–20
https://web.mit.edu/modiano/www/6.263/lec5-6.pdf
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: Little 定律
cn.description: 在相应长期平均存在且有限时，系统平均存量 L 等于到达率 λ 乘平均逗留时间 W；计量边界必须一致。
trigger: 想估算做完一项工作需要多久，手上只有在制品和吞吐量。
questions: L、λ、W 是否采用同一系统边界和时间单位？
avoid_when: 短期剧烈变化或持续积压时，不能直接把某天的存量代入长期平均关系来预测交付。
examples: 说明性示例：稳定流程平均有 12 项在制品，每天完成 3 项，对应平均周期约 4 天；这不承诺每项都在 4 天内完成。
cn.source_text:
Karl Sigman — Notes on Little’s Law (2009), §1.1, theorem 1.1
https://www.columbia.edu/~ks20/stochastic-I/stochastic-I-LL.pdf
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Little’s Law
en.description: When the relevant finite long-run averages exist, average system population L equals arrival rate λ times mean time in system W, using consistent boundaries.
trigger: We know work in progress and throughput but want to estimate average lead time.
questions: Do L, λ and W refer to the same boundary and time units?
avoid_when: A snapshot during rapid change or growing backlog cannot simply replace long-run averages for forecasting.
examples: Illustrative example: A stable process averages 12 items in progress and three completions daily: mean time is about four days, not a deadline for every item.
en.source_text:
Karl Sigman — Notes on Little’s Law (2009), §1.1, theorem 1.1
https://www.columbia.edu/~ks20/stochastic-I/stochastic-I-LL.pdf
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 在制品限制
cn.description: 为同时进行的工作数量设上限，满额时优先完成或解除已有工作的阻塞。
trigger: 同时开了很多任务，每个都完成了一点，却很久没有交付。
questions: 哪些已经开始的工作可以先完成？上限覆盖等待和阻塞项吗？
avoid_when: 上限过低可能让下游缺料；应结合流程、阻塞及吞吐观察调整。
examples: 说明性示例：评审列上限为 3，满额后团队先协助完成评审，再开始下一项开发；3 只是试验值。
cn.source_text:
Kanban University — The Official Guide to The Kanban Method, Limit Work in Progress / Manage Flow
https://kanban.university/kanban-guide/
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Work in Progress Limits
en.description: Cap simultaneous work; when capacity is full, finish or unblock existing items before starting more.
trigger: Many tasks have started, but few have finished.
questions: What can we finish first, and do limits count blocked and waiting items?
avoid_when: An excessively low limit may starve downstream work; adjust using flow and throughput observations.
examples: Illustrative example: Set a trial review limit of three. When full, help complete reviews before starting another feature; three is not a universal rule.
en.source_text:
Kanban University — The Official Guide to The Kanban Method, Limit Work in Progress / Manage Flow
https://kanban.university/kanban-guide/
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 拉动系统
cn.description: 根据下游需求和可用容量接入工作，通过明确的拉取信号协调流动。
trigger: 上游不停塞任务，下游只能被动接收。
questions: 谁发出接入信号？下游有容量且需要这项工作吗？
avoid_when: 需要明确接入规则和反馈；仅把推送改名为拉取不会解决超载。
examples: 说明性示例：评审列空出一个名额后，从已准备队列选取下一项；没有名额就先处理现有工作。
cn.source_text:
Kanban University — The Kanban Method Glossary, Pull Signals / Pull System / WIP Limits
https://kanban.university/glossary/
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Pull System
en.description: Admit work in response to downstream demand and available capacity, using explicit pull signals.
trigger: Upstream keeps pushing work that downstream cannot absorb.
questions: Who signals readiness, and does downstream both need the work and have capacity?
avoid_when: Clear admission rules and feedback are necessary; relabeling push as pull changes nothing.
examples: Illustrative example: When a review slot becomes free, select the next ready item; otherwise work on existing commitments.
en.source_text:
Kanban University — The Kanban Method Glossary, Pull Signals / Pull System / WIP Limits
https://kanban.university/glossary/
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 流动效率
cn.description: 工作项被实际处理的时间占其总经过时间的比例；统计前需约定起止点和时间口径。
trigger: 真正动手只用了几个小时，客户却等了一周。
questions: 等待发生在哪个交接点？活跃时间与总时间如何记录？
avoid_when: 比例不衡量结果价值或质量；不同时间口径的团队不宜直接比较。
examples: 说明性示例：同一营业时间口径下，一项任务处理 2 小时、共经过 20 小时，流动效率为 10%。
cn.source_text:
Julia Wester, Kanban University — Flow Efficiency: A great metric you probably aren’t using (2016-10-18), calculation
https://kanban.university/flow-efficiency-a-great-metric-you-probably-arent-using/
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Flow Efficiency
en.description: The share of total elapsed time during which a work item is actively processed, with agreed boundaries and time conventions.
trigger: Hands-on work took hours, but the customer waited a week.
questions: Where do handoffs wait, and how are active and elapsed time recorded?
avoid_when: The ratio does not measure value or quality; compare only consistent time conventions.
examples: Illustrative example: Using business hours throughout, two active hours within 20 elapsed hours gives 10% flow efficiency.
en.source_text:
Julia Wester, Kanban University — Flow Efficiency: A great metric you probably aren’t using (2016-10-18), calculation
https://kanban.university/flow-efficiency-a-great-metric-you-probably-arent-using/
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 资源利用率
cn.description: 衡量资源容量被需求占用的程度；简单稳定排队模型中可用到达率与服务能力之比表示。
trigger: 排班几乎没有空隙，一遇到额外请求就全部延期。
questions: 可用容量如何定义？为波动留下了多少余量？
avoid_when: 利用率不等于交付效率；复杂流程不能用一个平均值替代分环节分析。
examples: 说明性示例：某服务台每小时可处理 10 项，平均到达 9 项，对应负载 90%；仍需检查到达波动与等待。
cn.source_text:
Jérémie Gallien, MIT OCW 15.760B — Class 3: Capacity, slides 5, 18–20
https://www.ocw.mit.edu/courses/15-760b-introduction-to-operations-management-spring-2004/16dde953a29f89a4d2018361900ce886_lec3_capacity.pdf
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Resource Utilization
en.description: Measures demand relative to resource capacity; simple stable queueing models express it as arrival rate divided by service capacity.
trigger: Schedules have no slack, so every extra request delays other work.
questions: How is capacity defined, and what room remains for variation?
avoid_when: Utilization is not delivery efficiency; one average cannot describe every stage of a complex workflow.
examples: Illustrative example: A desk can process ten items hourly and receives nine on average: load is 90%, but variability and waiting still need examination.
en.source_text:
Jérémie Gallien, MIT OCW 15.760B — Class 3: Capacity, slides 5, 18–20
https://www.ocw.mit.edu/courses/15-760b-introduction-to-operations-management-spring-2004/16dde953a29f89a4d2018361900ce886_lec3_capacity.pdf
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 上下文切换
cn.description: 从一项任务转向另一项时，需要切换目标及规则，可能付出额外认知时间。
trigger: 一天不停切换项目，到下班却没有完成重要工作。
questions: 哪些切换可以合并或延后？返回原任务需要重建哪些信息？
avoid_when: 实验任务的切换成本不能直接当作所有岗位的固定损失比例。
examples: 说明性示例：写报告时每隔几分钟处理一条消息，回来都要重新确认论证进度；试着集中处理非紧急消息。
cn.source_text:
Rubinstein, Meyer & Evans (2001) — Executive control of cognitive processes in task switching, abstract; DOI 10.1037//0096-1523.27.4.763
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11518143/
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Context Switching
en.description: Changing tasks can require shifting goals and activating different rules, adding cognitive time costs.
trigger: The day is full of project switches but important work remains unfinished.
questions: Which switches can be deferred, and what must be reconstructed on return?
avoid_when: Laboratory switching costs do not establish a fixed productivity-loss percentage for every job.
examples: Illustrative example: A writer checks messages every few minutes and repeatedly reconstructs the argument; try batching nonurgent messages.
en.source_text:
Rubinstein, Meyer & Evans (2001) — Executive control of cognitive processes in task switching, abstract; DOI 10.1037//0096-1523.27.4.763
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11518143/
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 批量大小
cn.description: 一次处理或移交的工作数量；批量选择需要权衡准备成本、等待和反馈速度。
trigger: 为了省一次交接，把很多工作攒在一起才交付。
questions: 这是处理批量还是移交批量？缩小它会增加多少准备成本？
avoid_when: 准备成本高或任务不可拆分时，最小批量未必带来最好整体结果。
examples: 说明性示例：一次提交 20 篇文案才能审核会推迟首篇反馈；试行每 2 篇移交，并观察额外协调成本。
cn.source_text:
Art Byrne, Lean Enterprise Institute — Ask Art: Why Switch from Batch to Lean? (2021), setup time and batch discussion
https://www.lean.org/the-lean-post/articles/ask-art-why-switch-from-batch-to-lean/
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Batch Size
en.description: The number of items processed or transferred together; selection trades off setup cost, waiting and feedback speed.
trigger: Work is accumulated into a large handoff to save coordination effort.
questions: Is this a processing or transfer batch, and what setup cost would smaller batches add?
avoid_when: High setup costs or indivisible work can make the smallest batch unsuitable.
examples: Illustrative example: Submitting 20 articles together delays feedback on the first; try transferring two at a time and observe coordination cost.
en.source_text:
Art Byrne, Lean Enterprise Institute — Ask Art: Why Switch from Batch to Lean? (2021), setup time and batch discussion
https://www.lean.org/the-lean-post/articles/ask-art-why-switch-from-batch-to-lean/
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

cn.name: 局部优化
cn.description: 以某个部门或环节的指标为改进目标；它对系统整体的收益需要另行验证。
trigger: 每个部门都达标，客户收到结果的时间却没有改善。
questions: 局部指标改善后，整体完成量和等待发生了什么变化？
avoid_when: 局部改进本身有价值，不能仅因它是局部的就否定；需看整体影响。
examples: 说明性示例：开发用提交数衡量成绩，评审队列却持续变长；把提交增长与最终验收量一起检查。
cn.source_text:
TOC Institute — Theory of Constraints, The Core Idea / Constraints / What is TOC
https://www.tocinstitute.org/theory-of-constraints.html
2026-09-28 查阅。定义据来源概括；情境、问题和案例为本库编写。

en.name: Local Optimization
en.description: Improving a component or department metric; its benefit to the whole system needs separate verification.
trigger: Every department meets its targets, but customers still wait.
questions: After the local metric improves, what happens to total completions and waiting?
avoid_when: Local improvements can be useful; judge their system effect rather than rejecting them categorically.
examples: Illustrative example: Developers optimize commit counts while the review queue grows; examine accepted deliveries alongside local output.
en.source_text:
TOC Institute — Theory of Constraints, The Core Idea / Constraints / What is TOC
https://www.tocinstitute.org/theory-of-constraints.html
Reviewed 2026-09-28. Definition summarized from source; prompts and examples written for this library.

note.cn: TOC Institute 将五步聚焦法列为约束理论的核心改进流程。
note.en: TOC Institute presents the five focusing steps as a core TOC improvement process.

note.cn: 约束理论关注限制整体产出的因素；流程中的瓶颈是常见切入点，但不涵盖所有政策或市场约束。
note.en: TOC addresses limits on system output; a process bottleneck is a common starting point, not every policy or market constraint.

note.cn: 对比关注范围：局部指标与系统产出。TOC Institute 的链条类比解释了非约束环节提效可能无助于整体。
note.en: Contrast the scope of optimization: local metrics versus system output, as illustrated by TOC Institute’s chain analogy.

note.cn: Sigman 的讲义将 Little 定律作为排队论中的一般关系，并给出长期平均成立条件。
note.en: Sigman presents Little’s law as a general queueing relationship with conditions on long-run averages.

note.cn: MIT 容量讲义将利用率、变异和等待联系起来；具体等待量仍取决于所选排队模型。
note.en: MIT’s capacity lecture relates utilization, variation and waiting; quantitative predictions depend on the queueing model.

note.cn: Kanban University 将限制在制品作为建立拉动系统的机制；上限释放出可拉取工作的容量信号。
note.en: Kanban University describes WIP limits as a mechanism for establishing pull by exposing available capacity.

note.cn: Kanban 指南同时讨论在制品与切换成本；本库据此建议观察减少并行工作后切换是否减少。
note.en: The Kanban guide discusses WIP and switching costs; this library proposes checking whether fewer concurrent items reduce switching.

note.cn: 编者关联：限制并行工作与度量等待可配合检查流程改善；不保证降低上限就必然提高流动效率。
note.en: Editorial connection: WIP limits and waiting-time measurement can inform improvement; lower limits do not guarantee higher flow efficiency.

note.cn: 编者对照两份来源：流动效率以工作项为中心，资源利用率以容量为中心，两者分母和含义不同。
note.en: Editorial comparison of the two sources: flow efficiency concerns an item’s time, utilization concerns capacity; their denominators differ.

note.cn: 编者关联：LEI 讨论批量引起的等待，可用流动效率观察这些等待；还需计入准备成本。
note.en: Editorial connection: LEI discusses waiting induced by batches; flow efficiency can reveal it, alongside setup costs.

note.cn: 五步法从识别约束开始；确认当前瓶颈后可据此安排利用、配合与提升。
note.en: The steps begin with identifying a constraint; a verified current bottleneck can guide exploitation, subordination and elevation.

note.cn: 编者关联：Little 定律连接长期平均在制品、流率与时间，可用于理解 WIP 试验；它本身不指定最优上限。
note.en: Editorial connection: Little’s law connects long-run WIP, flow rate and time; it can inform WIP experiments but does not prescribe an optimal limit.
